name: Central Kitchen
desc:
A sealed-kitchen works that turns local produce, imported delicacies, and a great deal of institutional stubbornness into whatever food this world is known for. What comes out depends on who runs the colony: Hegemony ration kits, Tri-Tachyon luxury seafood, Persean stew packs, pirate spice mix, or hand-farmed artisanal produce. The other factions' specialties are imported for the tables of officers and executives. Built as a structure, so it does not take up an industry slot.

A shortage of any ingredient cuts into production.
